scope: P10 safe and actionable music failure reporting.
implemented: Missing yt-dlp or FFmpeg, access denial, bot check, unavailable or restricted video, region block, rate limit, network failure and playback stall map to fixed localized reason codes.
Raw provider stderr, internal paths and dependency errors remain server-side and are not rendered to clients.
Queue capacity and extraction backpressure fail explicitly without exceeding the 200-item bound.
A timed-out play request is reported as indeterminate and is not retried automatically, preventing duplicate queue entries.
Rejected and indeterminate slash commands return non-success outcomes so the composer retains the user's draft.

checks.command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/hooks/useMusicSlashCommand.test.ts src/utils/musicRequestError.test.ts src/hooks/ws/voiceEventHandlers.test.ts

remaining: Live YouTube smoke testing must exercise real 403, rate-limit and inaccessible-content responses without account cookies.
Packaged Windows acceptance must verify localized feedback and retained composer drafts.
release: Source and automated fixtures only; no commit, push, merge, deployment or Windows update was performed.
